messages:
emma: Quick sync 1: post-launch backlog popped. We have 3 items: flaky A/B rollout, embeddings drift for search, and UI overflow in model picker. Which to take into Sprint N+1?
ryan: list severity?
emma: A/B flaky = customer-impacting for two accounts (P0), embeddings = P1 for a partner, UI = P3.
devon: agree we must stop the A/B experiment and hotfix. looks like sampling race on rollout code.
lucas: embeddings: partner prefers temporary pin to previous model while we investigate. low-effort rollback.
ryan: plan: A) A/B hotfix (1.5 dev-days, include rollback plan), B) embeddings pin rollback (ops 2h), C) UI polish next sprint. anyone object?
emma: acceptance criteria for A/B fix: experiment stable for 24h on canary, no p99 latency regressions.
qa-bot: failing test added: ab-rollout-flaky.test with repro steps.
devon: I'll take the hotfix tomorrow AM and add a regression test.
lucas: ops will do the pin and notify partner; I'll update roadmap and move "advanced filtering" feature out by one sprint to free cycles.
ryan: tickets and tags: triage/p0, area/experiments; triage/rollback, area/embeddings.
emma: check-in 2025-06-25 16:00 PT to confirm outcomes. Thanks all.
